invoices_void_ck.name: invoices_void_ck
invoices_void_ck.value: "invoices"."status" <> 'anulada' or ("invoices"."void_reason" is not null and "invoices"."voided_by" is not null)

deliverables_final_file_ck.name: deliverables_final_file_ck
deliverables_final_file_ck.value: "production_deliverables"."status" not in ('finalizado','editado') or "production_deliverables"."final_file_url" is not null or "production_deliverables"."final_file_asset_id" is not null

publications_deliverable_network_uq.name: publications_deliverable_network_uq
publications_deliverable_network_uq.where: "publications"."deliverable_id" is not null and "publications"."status" not in ('reprogramada','no_aplica')

publications_confirmed_ck.name: publications_confirmed_ck
publications_confirmed_ck.value: "publications"."status" <> 'publicada' or ("publications"."confirmed_by" is not null and "publications"."confirmed_at" is not null)
